dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric narrowing of the 2D planar width originating at the mid-section and extending toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light lavender-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, categorized as a transitional phase between juvenile slate and mature white.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, high-contrast linear white marks visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle linear rake-like marks or superficial abrasions are visible on the lower dorsal plane near the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark circular aperture of the blowhole is clearly defined at the anterior dorsal midline.
